items.summary: Recommendation: freeze new growth spend and production experiments until finance measurement is decision-grade. AI spend is $940.70 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-25 across 39 instrumented sites, while Amazon revenue covers only 2026-09-21: $4.92 aggregate commission, $0 site-attributed income, 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, and 6 shipped items. The periods do not align, and the aggregate $4.92 cannot be assigned to any site; therefore no site revenue, ROI, contribution margin, payback, or causal lift is supported. The $940.70 is a known AI cost, but total contribution margin is not calculable because infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and other fixed costs are absent. Minimum finance evidence needed is a period-aligned daily ledger by site and shared fleet cost center covering AI, infrastructure, domains, labor allocation, affiliate commission, and attributable revenue. Until then, treat SEO impressions, clicks, sessions, conversions, affiliate clicks, and opportunity scores as operating signals—not financial performance—and prioritize repair/measurement work over new monetization experiments.
